title: How to Unlock and Encounter the Legendary Regis - Pokémon Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire: How

Pokémon Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire: How to unlock and catch the Legendary Regi Trio

Unlocking Regirock, Regice and Registeel is filled with puzzles, and it can get pretty difficult to solve them. But it is very rewarding once you find yourself in front of each of the three sealed Regis.
